svg.title: PartsPaddock logo directions
svg.desc: Three logo directions on a blue square with a cream chat bubble: A, a friendly bot head in the bubble with a cream touring-car silhouette on a track line below; B, the bot next to a pistol-grip RC transmitter whose steering wheel is an orange gear; C, a dark touring-car silhouette with orange gear wheels under a smaller bot head.
svg.text: Same palette and chat bubble; adds the bot and an RC touring car or a transmitter. Large = profile picture (round crop), small = 40 px.
A. Bot in the bubble, car on the track
C. Touring car with gear wheels
